description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Bierman Autism Centers is seeking a Junior to Mid-Level Full-Stack Developer for its HealthTech engineering team. The role builds and maintains secure, scalable web applications for healthcare providers, clinicians, and patients, with emphasis on patient data privacy and regulatory compliance.
Full-Stack Developer building healthcare applications with Next.js and Supabase, securing databases with RLS, and delivering tested, accessible features

Responsibilities:
• Full-Stack Development: Design, build, and ship end-to-end user features using Next.js, Tailwind CSS, TypeScript, and Supabase
• Database & Security Architecture: Write clean, performant SQL queries, manage database migrations, and enforce fine-grained access control using Supabase Row Level Security (RLS) policies
• Healthcare Security & Compliance: Implement robust encryption, secure API integrations, and access logs adhering to HIPAA, SOC 2, and HITRUST data security frameworks
• Frontend Performance & UX: Create responsive, accessible (WCAG compliant), and pixel-perfect UIs optimized for speed and cross-browser reliability
• DevSecOps & Deployment: Utilize Vercel CI/CD workflows, conduct automated security/vulnerability scans, and participate in code reviews focusing on quality and security
• Collaboration: Partner with cross-functional teams (Clinical, Product, Compliance) to refine requirements, estimate work, and iterate rapidly in an agile environment
• Develop automated tests to ensure business needs are met and allow for regression testing
• Ensure comprehensive technical documentation

Requirements:
• 1 to 4 years of full-stack web development experience in a modern
• JavaScript/TypeScript ecosystem
• Strong hands-on experience with Next.js (React) and modern CSS frameworks like Tailwind CSS
• Solid understanding of Supabase or PostgreSQL databases, including relational schema design and SQL
• Experience deploying and maintaining production applications on Vercel or similar serverless platforms
• Proficiency with modern RESTful APIs, GraphQL, and serverless API routes
• Excellent debugging and optimization skills
• Proficient in using Azure DevOps or other version control tools
• Ability to organize and prioritize critical projects
• Strong security-first development approach, understanding principles like Least Privilege, Row Level Security, and secure session management

Preferred:
• Prior experience building modern software applications within the Healthcare or HealthTech sector
• Familiarity with compliance and security standards: HIPAA, SOC 2 Type II, or HITRUST
• Exposure to DevSecOps practices (static security analysis, automated compliance checking, dependency auditing)
• Experience building third-party API integrations (e.g., EHR/EMR platforms, scheduling tools, billing systems, or HL7/FHIR standards)
• Experience with state management and automated testing (Jest, Playwright, Cypress)
• Strong knowledge of DevOps
• Hands-on experience using AI coding assistants (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor) to accelerate development, optimize code quality, and automate repetitive workflows while maintaining strict data privacy and security practices
• Experience with real-time architectures, WebSockets, or Supabase Realtime subscriptions for collaborative or live-updating workflows
